tldr: 美股終止連九紅，中東緊張升溫推升油價與美債殖利率，道瓊重挫逾620點。
COMPUTEX聚光燈仍在台廠AI硬體鏈，黃仁勳盛讚鴻海Vera Rubin機櫃，伺服器族群看好下半年爆發。
美國首波301調查擬以強迫勞動為由對台加徵至少10%關稅，經濟部稱不會與122條款疊加。
主計總處預估CPI自第2季起季季踩2%紅線，穆迪同時確認台灣主權評等Aa3、展望穩定。
博通季度營收小幅不如預期，但因AI客製晶片需求強勁，將下季營收展望大幅上修。

items.title_zh: 台積電股東會領銜 6月4日重要財經行事曆
items.title_en: TSMC AGM headlines a packed June 4 economic calendar
items.summary_zh: 台積電於6月4日召開股東常會，是當日滿檔財經行事曆中最受矚目的一場，市場將關注公司對AI需求、產能擴張與股東回報的最新說法。由於台積電是大盤權值最重的成分股，其談話基調往往牽動整體台股氣氛；本次股東會適逢AI硬體題材主導台北盤面之際，董事會與經營層的展望被視為觀察下半年市場風向的重要指標，後續法人解讀與外資動向值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. holds its annual general meeting on June 4, the marquee event on a busy corporate and macro calendar that investors are watching for fresh commentary on AI demand, capacity expansion and shareholder returns. As the heaviest weighting in the benchmark, TSMC's tone tends to set the mood for the broader bourse, and the meeting comes as the AI hardware narrative dominates Taipei trading.

items.title_zh: 6月4日盤前：全球AI鏈重新定價 台股維持健康強勢整理
items.title_en: Pre-market view: global AI chain repricing, Taiwan shares in healthy strong consolidation
items.summary_zh: 經濟日報6月4日盤前分析指出，台股呈現「健康」的強勢整理格局，隨全球AI供應鏈重新定價，類股輪流表態、輪動接棒。盤面強勢由多族群分散承接而非單一集中，被解讀為指數底部結構穩健的訊號。在AI硬體與伺服器題材續強、權值股扮演定海神針的背景下，盤前觀點認為短線震盪屬整理性質，後續仍須觀察外資買賣超與量能是否同步放大以延續多頭格局。
items.summary_en: The June 4 pre-market commentary frames Taiwan equities as undergoing a "healthy" strong-side consolidation, with sector leadership rotating as the global AI supply chain is repriced. Strength is described as broadening across groups rather than concentrated, a pattern that strategists read as constructive for the index's underlying tone even amid day-to-day swings.

items.title_zh: 高盛看好日月光投控、京元電子、鴻勁
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs flags ASE, KYEC and Hon-Jin as top picks
items.summary_zh: 高盛證券出具看好報告，點名半導體封測族群中的日月光投控、京元電子與鴻勁為首選標的。此一推薦反映市場對先進封裝與測試產能仍是AI晶片週期結構性瓶頸的預期，認為隨晶圓前段產出持續放大，後段封裝測試業者可望承接延續性需求。封測股近期在外資點火下成為盤面焦點，投資人後續可留意相關個股的訂單能見度、產能利用率與毛利率變化是否支撐評價續揚。
items.summary_en: Goldman Sachs issued a constructive call on Taiwan's semiconductor testing and packaging names, highlighting ASE Technology Holding, King Yuan Electronics (KYEC) and Hon-Jin as preferred plays. The recommendation reflects expectations that advanced packaging and testing capacity remains a structural bottleneck in the AI chip cycle, positioning back-end specialists to capture sustained demand as front-end output scales up.

items.title_zh: 南亞科5月營收年增7.3倍 連七月創高 法人看好獲利三級跳
items.title_en: Nanya Technology May revenue jumps 7.3x year-on-year, seventh straight record
items.summary_zh: 記憶體廠南亞科公布5月營收較去年同期暴增7.3倍，並改寫連續第七個月的新高紀錄。法人看好獲利將隨營收同步跳升，反映DRAM價格與需求在AI與伺服器升級週期帶動下全面回暖。記憶體族群在報價轉強、供需吃緊的環境中營運動能明顯改善，南亞科連月創高顯示產業景氣處於上行階段；後續可觀察報價走勢、客戶庫存回補力道，以及公司產能與資本支出規劃是否進一步上調。
items.summary_en: Memory maker Nanya Technology reported May revenue surging 7.3 times from a year earlier, marking its seventh consecutive monthly record. Analysts expect earnings to follow the top line higher, reflecting the broad recovery in DRAM pricing and demand that has lifted memory names through the AI and server upgrade cycle.

items.title_zh: 金寶兩周大漲近50% 主力到底看見了什麼？
items.title_en: Kinpo soars nearly 50% in two weeks as big money piles in
items.summary_zh: 金寶電子股價兩周內飆漲近五成，引發市場對主力資金布局意圖的高度關注。此波急漲與電子代工（EMS）及低軌衛星供應鏈題材的整體熱度相關，動能型買盤積極追價，但推升股價的基本面催化劑仍是市場揣測焦點。在題材股輪動、資金尋找落後補漲標的之際，金寶成為短線熱門；投資人宜留意股價已大幅反映預期，後續須觀察成交量、籌碼集中度與實質訂單能見度，慎防追高風險。
items.summary_en: Shares of Kinpo Electronics have rallied close to 50% over two weeks, drawing attention to what major players may be positioning for. The sharp move comes amid broader interest in EMS and low-earth-orbit satellite supply-chain themes, with momentum traders chasing the stock even as the underlying fundamental catalyst remains a topic of market speculation.

items.title_zh: 輝達黃仁勳跑攤 按讚鴻海Vera Rubin機櫃 暗示下半年業績爆發
items.title_en: Nvidia's Jensen Huang tours Hon Hai booth, praises Vera Rubin rack, hints at H2 surge
items.summary_zh: 台北國際電腦展（COMPUTEX）次日，輝達執行長黃仁勳再度展開供應鏈攤位巡禮，首站抵達鴻海（富士康）攤位，盛讚鴻海設計的輝達新款Vera Rubin裝置「非常優雅」。其親自站台與正面評語被市場解讀為對台廠夥伴的強力背書，也釋出新世代AI伺服器需求可望帶動組裝與零組件鏈下半年業績爆發的訊號。在AI硬體題材主導盤面之際，黃仁勳的行程牽動相關供應鏈股價表現，後續訂單與出貨節奏成為觀察重點。
items.summary_en: On the second day of COMPUTEX, Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang resumed his supply-chain booth crawl, stopping first at Hon Hai (Foxconn) and calling its newly designed Nvidia Vera Rubin device "very elegant." The visit and his commentary were read as a strong endorsement of Taiwanese partners and a signal that next-generation AI server demand could drive an explosive second half for the assembly and component chain.

items.title_zh: 信驊：今年接單比預期好 供應鏈瓶頸效應 維持七成毛利率難度拉高
items.title_en: Aspeed says orders beat expectations, but supply-chain bottlenecks pressure 70% gross margin
items.summary_zh: 股王信驊董事長林鴻明表示，AI伺服器與一般型伺服器需求同步升溫，客戶拉貨動能強勁，今年接單明顯優於預期，已有客戶提前規劃2027年需求。不過他坦言供應鏈瓶頸猶存，使維持公司約七成毛利率的難度升高，但仍看好下半年營收將較上半年明顯成長。信驊為伺服器管理晶片（BMC）龍頭，其接單與毛利展望被視為伺服器景氣與AI基礎建設投資的領先指標，後續供應鏈瓶頸何時緩解值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: Aspeed Technology chairman Lin Hung-ming said AI-server and general-server demand are heating up simultaneously, with strong customer pull-in and bookings clearly above expectations—some clients are already planning 2027 needs. Persistent supply-chain bottlenecks, however, make holding the company's roughly 70% gross margin more challenging, even as he expects second-half revenue to grow meaningfully over the first half.

items.title_zh: 仁寶AI伺服器邁進爆發期 相關營收占比年底估翻倍
items.title_en: Compal's AI server business enters explosive phase, revenue share to double by year-end
items.summary_zh: 仁寶電腦總經理伯納多羅表示，公司AI伺服器業務已邁入爆發成長期，相關營收占比可望從年初水準翻倍、至年底達一成以上。隨美國新廠產能於下半年全面到位，仁寶力拚2027年AI伺服器業績達三位數成長。代工大廠積極切入AI伺服器以提升產品組合與毛利，並透過海外設廠分散地緣風險、就近供應美系客戶；後續可觀察新廠良率爬坡、客戶認證進度與營收占比實際提升幅度，驗證爆發成長的可持續性。
items.summary_en: Compal Electronics president Bernardo Lo said the company's AI-server business has entered an explosive growth phase, with the revenue contribution set to double from the start of the year to more than 10% by year-end. As new U.S. plant capacity comes fully online in the second half, Compal is targeting triple-digit growth in AI-server sales in 2027.

items.title_zh: 微軟推首款自家AI代理「Scout」 激勵PC台系鏈 雙A、仁寶迎商機
items.title_en: Microsoft's first in-house "Scout" AI agent boosts Taiwan PC chain
items.summary_zh: 微軟搶攻AI代理（AI agent）商機，於年度Build開發者大會發表旗下首款自家產品Microsoft Scout，定位為與Outlook、OneDrive等服務整合的全天候AI助理。微軟跨入代理式AI被視為將帶動台系PC相關供應鏈，包括「雙A」（華碩、宏碁）與仁寶等廠商受惠，因端側與雲端AI功能可望刺激新一輪硬體升級換機需求。市場關注AI PC滲透率提升的實際拉貨節奏，以及軟硬體整合所創造的長期換機與規格升級動能。
items.summary_en: Microsoft unveiled its first in-house AI-agent product, Microsoft Scout, at its annual Build developer conference, positioned as an around-the-clock AI assistant integrated with Outlook, OneDrive and other services. The push into agentic AI is seen benefiting Taiwan's PC-related supply chain—including the "double-A" names and Compal—as on-device and cloud AI features spur a new hardware upgrade cycle.

items.title_zh: 衛星不僅是通訊 台灣大董座蔡明忠更看重整個太空產業
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile chairman eyes the whole space industry, not just satellite comms
items.summary_zh: 台灣大哥大董事長蔡明忠表示，集團看重的並非僅止於將衛星視為通訊工具，而是整個太空產業的廣闊商機。談話顯示其策略企圖橫跨新興的低軌衛星與太空經濟價值鏈，呼應台灣電信與科技集團競相卡位次世代連網與基礎建設的趨勢。低軌衛星題材近期帶動相關供應鏈與電信業者股價，市場關注業者在頻譜、地面設備、終端與服務模式上的實質布局，以及太空產業由題材走向營收貢獻的時程。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Mobile chairman Daniel Tsai signalled the group sees opportunity across the entire space sector rather than treating satellites purely as a communications play. The comments point to a broader strategic ambition spanning the emerging low-earth-orbit and space-economy value chain, as Taiwanese telecom and tech groups jostle for position in next-generation connectivity and infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 台化轉型切入半導體鏈 已可創造年產值逾百億
items.title_en: Formosa Chemicals pivots into the semiconductor chain, eyeing NT$10bn+ annual output
items.summary_zh: 台化（台灣化纖）積極轉型，跨入半導體供應鏈，公司表示相關業務已可創造逾新台幣百億元的年產值。這家傳統石化與紡織集團正朝高附加價值材料重新定位，是傳產老牌製造業者搶搭先進製程結構性需求的縮影。在本業景氣波動、追求轉型升級的壓力下，切入半導體材料有助分散風險、提升獲利結構；市場關注其產品認證、客戶導入與量產規模能否如期放大，並進一步觀察集團整體轉型藍圖的後續進展。
items.summary_en: Formosa Chemicals & Fibre is transforming its business by moving into the semiconductor supply chain, a shift the company says can already generate annual output value exceeding NT$10 billion. The traditional petrochemical and textile group is repositioning toward higher-value materials, part of a broader effort by legacy manufacturers to ride the structural demand from advanced chipmaking.

items.title_zh: 《外送員權益保障及外送平臺管理法》將上路 Uber Eats：不排除調漲價格
items.title_en: Delivery-platform management act looms; Uber Eats may raise prices
items.summary_zh: 《外送員權益保障及外送平臺管理法》預定7月上路，外送平台營運成本面臨重大結構性墊高。Uber Eats代理總經理郭獻文表示，不排除對消費者端調整價格，顯示兩大美食外送平台的漲價計畫已箭在弦上。新法旨在強化外送員權益保障與平台管理，業者勞動成本與合規負擔上升，恐部分轉嫁至消費者與餐廳端。後續可觀察費率調整幅度、訂單量與市占變化，以及新制對整體外送生態與零工經濟運作模式的影響。
items.summary_en: With the Act on the Protection of Delivery Workers' Rights and Management of Delivery Platforms set to take effect in July, food-delivery operators face a major structural rise in operating costs. Uber Eats acting general manager Kuo Hsien-wen said the platform does not rule out adjusting prices on the consumer side, signalling that both leading food-delivery players are preparing price hikes.

items.title_zh: 賣場殺蟲劑燒出大災情 判賠97萬只是開始…8家產險求償3.78億
items.title_en: Eight non-life insurers seek NT$378m over toy-store pesticide blaze
items.summary_zh: 一起兒童在賣場玩弄殺蟲劑引發大火的案件進入賠償階段，首波判賠新台幣97萬元被形容僅是開端。已先行理賠的八家產險公司，正循代位求償向責任方追討約新台幣3.78億元，凸顯重大損失事件中本國產險業所承擔的求償與代位曝險規模。此案反映產險公司在巨災理賠後透過法律途徑追償的實務，後續判決結果與求償金額認定，將牽動相關業者損益與再保安排；同時也提醒零售與公共場所的風險管理與責任保險需求。
items.summary_en: A case stemming from children playing with insecticide at a retail store, which triggered a major fire, has moved into the compensation phase—an initial NT$970,000 award is described as just the beginning. Eight property-and-casualty (non-life) insurers that paid out claims are now pursuing roughly NT$378 million in recoveries, underscoring the scale of subrogation exposure carried by Taiwan's general-insurance sector in large-loss events.

items.title_zh: 投資大趨勢論壇18日登場／統一投信基金經理林良一 主被動ETF互補配置
items.title_en: Investment forum on June 18: UPAMC's Lin Liang-yi pitches active-passive ETF complementarity
items.summary_zh: 在6月18日登場的「投資大趨勢論壇」前，統一投信基金經理林良一倡議以主動式與被動式ETF互補的配置思維建構投資組合。此一觀點反映台灣ETF投資族群日益成熟，業者引導客戶採取兼顧指數追蹤效率與主動選股的混合式資產配置。隨ETF商品線持續擴張、規模快速成長，主被動互補成為財富管理與資產配置的重要討論議題；對高資產與一般投資人而言，理解兩類工具的角色分工有助於控管風險與追求長期報酬，後續可留意相關新品發行與資金流向。
items.summary_en: Ahead of the "Investment Megatrends Forum" on June 18, UPAMC (President Securities Investment Trust) fund manager Lin Liang-yi advocates a portfolio approach that pairs active and passive ETFs as complementary building blocks. The view reflects the growing sophistication of Taiwan's ETF investor base, with managers steering clients toward blended allocations that combine index-tracking efficiency with active selection.

items.title_zh: 投資大趨勢論壇18日登場／中信美國數據及電力ETF經理人陳雯卿 AI新基建成長紅利
items.title_en: Forum spotlight: CTBC's Chen Wen-ching on AI new-infrastructure growth dividend
items.summary_zh: 同樣為6月18日論壇暖身，中國信託投信美國數據及電力ETF經理人陳雯卿，將AI「新基建」定義為投資人可掌握的結構性成長紅利。此題材反映市場對支撐AI建置的資料中心、電力與電力設備價值鏈的配置興趣升高，主題式ETF被視為取得分散布局的工具。隨AI資本支出推升電力與基礎設施需求，相關主題基金成為財富管理討論焦點；投資人宜留意題材評價、產業景氣循環與ETF追蹤標的的集中度，並評估其在整體資產配置中的角色與風險。
items.summary_en: Also previewing the June 18 forum, CTBC Investments ETF manager Chen Wen-ching, who runs a U.S. data-and-power ETF, frames AI "new infrastructure" as a structural growth dividend for investors. The theme captures rising allocation interest in the data-center, electricity and power-equipment value chain underpinning the AI build-out, positioning thematic ETFs as a way to gain diversified exposure.

items.title_zh: 美國301對台課10%關稅 經部：不會與122條款疊加
items.title_en: U.S. Section 301 ruling would add 10% tariff on Taiwan; trade ministry says no stacking with Section 122
items.summary_zh: 美國於6月2日公布首波301調查結果，針對強迫勞動議題擬對台灣、歐盟等14個經濟體加徵至少10%關稅，並對中國大陸、日本、南韓等46個經濟體加徵12.5%關稅，後續將在徵詢各界意見並召開聽證會後生效。台灣經濟部回應，301關稅不會與既有的122條款疊加課徵，意在控制對出口業者的累計衝擊。此舉牽動台美貿易關係與出口產業成本結構，後續須關注最終稅率、生效時程、適用品項，以及政府協商與業者因應海外布局調整的進展。
items.summary_en: Washington on June 2 published the first batch of Section 301 findings, proposing at least a 10% tariff on Taiwan, the EU and 14 economies over forced-labor concerns, and 12.5% on 46 economies including China, Japan and South Korea, to take effect after consultations and hearings. Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs said the 301 duties would not be stacked on top of the existing Section 122 measure, aiming to limit the cumulative burden on exporters.

items.title_zh: 通膨升溫 CPI恐季季踩2%紅線 國際油價、極端氣候為下半年變數
items.title_en: Inflation heats up: CPI seen breaching the 2% red line every quarter
items.summary_zh: 主計總處最新預測，自今年第2季起，消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率將季季超過2%通膨警戒線，高點預估落在第3季的2.24%。官員示警，下半年須高度關注極端氣候與國際油價影響，若衝擊蔬果供應，物價恐再走高。通膨黏著度升高將牽動民眾實質購買力、央行貨幣政策節奏與市場利率預期；在油價因地緣風險波動、梅雨與颱風季可能擾動農產供給的背景下，物價走勢與政策因應成為下半年總體經濟的關鍵觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics forecasts that, from the second quarter onward, the consumer price index will exceed the 2% inflation-alert line every quarter, with the peak projected at 2.24% in the third quarter. Officials flagged extreme weather and international oil prices as key second-half variables, warning that disruptions to fruit and vegetable supply could push prices higher still.

items.title_zh: 財政部：穆迪維持台灣「Aa3」評等 展望「穩定」
items.title_en: Moody's reaffirms Taiwan's Aa3 rating with stable outlook
items.summary_zh: 財政部於6月3日表示，國際信評機構穆迪（Moody's）確認維持台灣主權信用評等為「Aa3」、展望「穩定」，肯定台灣穩健的財政管理與強勁的財政表現。此一評等再確認有助支撐台灣的籌資成本與國際投資人信心，顯示信評機構認為在全球貿易與地緣政治逆風下，台灣財政基本面仍維持穩定。主權評等是觀察國家財政體質與舉債條件的重要指標，後續可留意財政收支、債務水準與外部環境變化是否影響評等展望。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance said on June 3 that Moody's confirmed the island's sovereign credit rating at "Aa3" with a "stable" outlook, recognising sound fiscal management and strong fiscal performance. The reaffirmation underpins Taiwan's funding cost and investor confidence, signalling that the rating agency sees fiscal fundamentals holding steady despite global trade and geopolitical headwinds.

items.title_zh: GDP成長 製造業居首功
items.title_en: GDP growth led by manufacturing
items.summary_zh: 最新數據顯示，台灣經濟成長的首要動能來自製造業，凸顯以出口為導向的生產活動——特別是科技與AI相關硬體——持續扮演經濟擴張的支柱。製造業的高貢獻反映台灣經濟對全球科技循環的高度依賴，相對而言內需相關部門的表現則較為分歧。在AI與半導體需求暢旺、出口動能強勁的背景下，製造業成為支撐成長的關鍵；惟經濟結構過度集中於特定產業，亦使整體景氣對外需與科技週期波動較為敏感，後續內外需是否更均衡值得觀察。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's economic growth was driven first and foremost by the manufacturing sector, according to the latest data, underscoring how export-oriented production—particularly tech and AI-related hardware—continues to anchor the island's expansion. The manufacturing contribution highlights the economy's reliance on the global tech cycle even as domestic-demand sectors face a more mixed picture.

items.title_zh: 從美國關稅變局看台商布局：東協能否成為下一個重點區域？
items.title_en: From U.S. tariff shifts to Taiwanese supply chains: can ASEAN become the next hub?
items.summary_zh: 在地緣政治升溫與新一波關稅變局衝擊下，台商加速調整海外布局。近年投資數據顯示，西進中國大陸的黃金時代已然落幕，東協正躍升為台商全球布局的戰略新核心，呈現資金、產能與供應鏈由中國向東南亞重新配置的結構性轉移。此趨勢與美中貿易摩擦、供應鏈去風險（de-risking）及客戶要求分散生產基地密切相關；對台灣產業而言，東協既是製造腹地也是新興市場，後續須關注當地基礎設施、人力成本、政策誘因與地緣風險，以及對台灣本地投資與就業的長期影響。
items.summary_en: Amid escalating geopolitics and a fresh wave of tariff changes, Taiwanese businesses are accelerating overseas relocation. Recent investment data show the golden age of westward expansion into mainland China has ended, with ASEAN rising as the new strategic core of Taiwanese firms' global footprint—a structural reallocation of capital, capacity and supply chains away from China.

items.title_zh: 去年減碳成績單未達標 環長彭啓明估減碳9% 2030年再減20%挑戰大
items.title_en: Carbon-cut report card misses target; environment minister estimates 9% reduction, 2030 goal looks tough
items.summary_zh: 環境部公布最新國家溫室氣體排放清冊，2024年溫室氣體淨排放量較基準年（2005年）減少6.59%，呈現連續第三年穩定下降趨勢。部長彭啓明估計減碳幅度可達約9%，但坦言2030年再減20%的目標挑戰艱鉅；能源部門碳排與基準年相比，更是除金融海嘯的2008、2009年外的低點。減碳進度攸關淨零路徑、產業碳成本與能源轉型；在用電需求隨AI與製造擴張持續上升之際，如何兼顧供電穩定、減碳目標與產業競爭力，將是政策後續須權衡的重點。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Environment released its latest national greenhouse-gas inventory, showing 2024 net emissions down 6.59% from the 2005 base year—a third straight year of steady decline. Minister Peng Chi-ming estimates reductions reaching about 9%, but cautioned that the 2030 target of a further 20% cut presents a significant challenge, with the energy sector's emissions among the lowest relative to the base year outside the financial-crisis years.

items.title_zh: 川普：伊朗已同意不擁有核武
items.title_en: Trump says Iran has agreed not to possess nuclear weapons
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普表示，伊朗已同意不擁有核子武器；此一談話在中東外交與能源市場高度波動之際受到台灣媒體關注。由於油價對中東區域緊張極為敏感，核議題若出現降溫跡象將受全球投資人密切追蹤；惟美伊整體談判進展訊號分歧，地緣政治風險溢價仍居高不下。中東局勢牽動國際油價、通膨預期與避險資產表現，後續須觀察談判是否實質推進、區域衝突是否再起，以及對原油供給與全球風險情緒的連鎖影響。
items.summary_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Iran has agreed not to possess nuclear weapons, a remark carried by Taiwanese media amid a volatile period for Middle East diplomacy and energy markets. Any de-escalation on the nuclear file would be closely watched by global investors given oil's sensitivity to regional tensions, though conflicting signals on the broader U.S.-Iran negotiations have kept risk premiums elevated.

items.title_zh: 美股終止連九紅 道瓊重挫620點（2026-06-03）
items.title_en: U.S. stocks snap nine-day win streak as Dow tumbles 620 points (2026-06-03)
items.summary_zh: 美股6月3日的紀錄行情止步，中東緊張情勢再起推升油價與美債殖利率。標普500指數下跌0.74%、那斯達克指數跌0.89%，道瓊工業指數重挫620.72點、跌幅1.21%，終結連續九個交易日的漲勢。油價走高與債券殖利率上揚全面壓抑股市，晶片與軟體類股成為尾盤主要拖累。
items.summary_en: Wall Street's record run stalled on June 3 as renewed Middle East tensions lifted oil and Treasury yields. The S&P 500 fell 0.74% and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.89%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average sank 620.72 points, or 1.21%, snapping a nine-day winning streak. Higher crude prices and rising bond yields pressured equities broadly, with chip and software names among the heaviest drags into the close.

items.title_zh: 博通營收小幅不如預期 但因AI晶片需求 大幅上修下季展望（2026-06-03）
items.title_en: Broadcom revenue narrowly misses, but guides Q3 sharply higher on AI chips (2026-06-03)
items.summary_zh: 博通公布會計年度第二季營收成長48%至221.9億美元，略低於市場預期的222.7億美元，惟調整後每股盈餘2.44美元優於預期。AI半導體營收年增143%、達108億美元。公司預估第三季營收約294億美元、年增84%，高於華爾街預期，反映客製化AI晶片與網通設備需求強勁。
items.summary_en: Broadcom reported fiscal Q2 revenue up 48% to $22.19 billion, just shy of the $22.27 billion consensus, while adjusted EPS of $2.44 beat estimates. AI semiconductor revenue jumped 143% year-on-year to $10.8 billion. The company guided Q3 revenue to roughly $29.4 billion—up 84% and above Wall Street expectations—on robust demand for custom AI chips and networking gear.

items.title_zh: CrowdStrike財測偏弱股價重挫 財報季持續發酵（2026-06-03）
items.title_en: CrowdStrike slides on soft guidance as earnings season rolls on (2026-06-03)
items.summary_zh: 資安公司CrowdStrike因第二季營收財測平淡而股價大跌約10%，加重當日科技股的低迷氣氛。市場反應凸顯本財報季中，評價偏高的軟體類股正承受高度預期壓力，即便整體財報並非全然不佳，只要展望不如預期仍可能引發劇烈修正。
items.summary_en: Cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike fell sharply after issuing lacklustre second-quarter revenue guidance, dropping about 10% and adding to the day's downbeat tone in tech. The reaction underscored how high expectations are weighing on richly valued software names this earnings season, even where headline results were not disastrous.

items.title_zh: 中東緊張再起 油價勁揚 布蘭特原油站上98美元（2026-06-03）
items.title_en: Oil surges on renewed Middle East fears, Brent tops $98 (2026-06-03)
items.summary_zh: 國際油價因伊朗相關緊張情勢再起、供給風險疑慮升溫而勁揚，布蘭特原油上漲約2%、突破每桶98美元。地緣政治風險溢價延續近期一連串漲勢，衝擊航空與汽車等對油價敏感的類股，並透過墊高通膨與利率路徑疑慮，回過頭來壓抑整體市場風險情緒。
items.summary_en: Crude prices jumped as renewed tensions involving Iran reignited supply-risk concerns, with Brent climbing about 2% to top $98 a barrel. The geopolitical risk premium added to a string of recent gains, weighing on energy-sensitive sectors such as airlines and carmakers and feeding back into higher inflation and rate-path worries across markets.

items.title_zh: 歐股收低 市場預期歐洲央行6月11日升息1碼（2026-06-03）
items.title_en: European stocks slip; markets price ECB quarter-point hike on June 11 (2026-06-03)
items.summary_zh: 歐洲股市6月3日小幅收低，油價勁揚約2%以航空與汽車類股受創最深；泛歐STOXX 600指數下跌0.1%，德國、法國走低，西班牙IBEX 35為主要市場中唯一上漲者。市場高度預期歐洲央行將於6月11日升息1碼至2.25%，並普遍視為因應能源衝擊的預防性措施，而非長期緊縮循環的起點。
items.summary_en: European equities edged lower on June 3 as oil's roughly 2% jump hit airlines and carmakers hardest; the STOXX 600 eased 0.1%, with Germany and France lower and Spain's IBEX 35 the lone major gainer. Markets firmly expect the European Central Bank to raise rates a quarter-point to 2.25% on June 11, viewed mainly as a precaution against the energy shock rather than the start of a long tightening cycle.
